Legend profiles and timeline: facts were checked for confidence before inclusion. Anything uncertain is in an amber note. Figures for players still active are exact as of the date shown on their profile, with the source named, and are re-checked every day; tap Update to load the newest check. World Cup matches, goals, squads, tables and awards (1930–2022) come from the Fjelstul World Cup Database by Joshua C. Fjelstul, Ph.D., used under CC-BY-SA 4.0. This page's World Cup data is shared under the same licence. 2026 World Cup matches, squads, line-ups and cards come from openfootball worldcup.json (public domain), checked against Wikipedia and FIFA award reports. All-time assists: Planet Football and Al Jazeera (Opta).
